dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white spots are visible on the wing coverts and primaries, though they form discrete spots rather than continuous horizontal bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent white elliptical spots are clearly visible against the dark background of the flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, distinct, roughly triangular reddish-orange patch is visible on the posterior head/nape area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: The transition boundary is indistinct, characterized by a gradual blending of similar gray tones between the crown and mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail feathers display a high-contrast transverse black-and-white barred pattern.
